title: Why Christians Keep Thinking the World Is Ending

top_liked.author: @tymurray2792
top_liked.text: The "world" as we know it does end, when we die.

top_liked.author: @davidstair9657
top_liked.text: I became a nurse at 35. After I left dispensational theology. When I was saved at twenty years old, I was told that there was no point in higher education as the end of the world was happening. Any day now. Fuck those assholes.

top_liked.author: @David-c4d3p
top_liked.text: That end of the world shit is all ego.  People want to believe they're special and not just one of billions who have walked this earth.

top_liked.author: @jaydenglimsboro2309
top_liked.text: It’s been very old it’s like I don’t get how people can wait decades after decades and centuries after centuries and still hope for an end that never made sense to me

top_liked.text: If the world is ending it absolves me from the responsibility to make it better. God's will be done. Nothing little ol' me can do about it.
